outOfScope: Changing the BB-061 caller-facing ContextRequirement/ContextResolution schema or Core pre-render resolution port.
Shipping or embedding Zoekt, Serena, SolidLSP, Graphiti or Cognee binaries/runtime dependencies inside ExHarness.
Adding a provider-selection LLM or exposing provider/tool selection to the model.
Adding durable ContextResolution storage, cache reuse/invalidation or replay lifecycle; BB-063 owns that.
Implementing the post-foundation Context Graph product or automatic progressive runtime retrieval.
Moving product/domain scheduling, acceptance, publication, recovery or external-effect authority into Oracle.
constraints: Provider capability metadata and operations remain Oracle-internal; ContextRequirement never names providerId, transport, tool or operation.
Source identity is independent of retrieval family: lexical, semantic and structural providers over repository code must preserve the same repository ref/snapshot/currentness contract.
CURRENT retrieval cannot let an index self-certify freshness; indexed/provider snapshot identity must be comparable with an authoritative source-snapshot observation.
The first RetrievalPlanner is deterministic and budget-reserving; model-assisted planning is deferred until a matched benchmark proves value worth another model turn.
Exact repository/artifact providers from BB-060 and semantic contract/Core seam from BB-061 are dependency inputs, not redefined by BB-062.
Public GitHub implementation evidence must satisfy the >=1,000-star rule and record exact source pin/license at the research check.
Worker execution remains unauthorized until researchGaps are empty and a new exact Jev readiness judgment is SATISFIED.
invariants: Application/domain controllers own work semantics, acceptance, publication, recovery and product authority; Oracle only resolves context.
Every ContextResolution is bounded by explicit requirement/budget and preserves source provenance/currentness; missing or ambiguous required evidence fails closed.
Oracle is infrastructure-owned and provider/planner internals do not become model-visible scheduling authority or Core/Application implementation ownership.
architectureDecisions: D1 — SourceCatalog is an explicit composition-time registry below Oracle, not a model-visible generic tool registry. Duplicate provider ids or ambiguous source-authority registrations fail closed.

D2 — Retrieval provider descriptor fields are providerId, sourceKinds, operations, snapshotModes, validatorKinds and optional languageIds. Provider priority/policy is owned by RetrievalPlanner, not self-declared by the provider.
D3 — Internal operations are READ_EXACT, SEARCH_LEXICAL, LOOKUP_SYMBOL, FIND_REFERENCES, STRUCTURAL_MAP, TRAVERSE_GRAPH and FETCH_EXTERNAL. These verbs never enter ContextRequirement.

D4 — ProviderCandidate preserves evidenceId, source kind/ref/snapshotRef/itemRef, validators, provenance and content. providerId/operation/score/rank/latency are diagnostic providerEvidence only and do not become semantic source identity/currentness authority.

D5 — SourceCatalog separately registers a source snapshot authority capable of resolving/validating authoritative snapshots. A retrieval index cannot satisfy CURRENT merely by reporting its own indexed revision; stale indexedSnapshotRef versus authoritative snapshot is STALE.

D6 — The first RetrievalPlanner is deterministic. Exact itemRefs prefer READ_EXACT. Repository semantic needs without exact itemRefs use semantic-code and lexical capabilities within the declared provider-call budget; lexical remains fallback when semantic lookup is unsupported.

D7 — Semantic-code planning sends a normalized semantic query to an injected symbolClient and may use returned symbol/reference identities for bounded FIND_REFERENCES. The caller does not supply LSP commands.
D8 — Structural map is an Oracle-internal bounded projection over normalized definition/reference edges, inspired by Aider. It is not a primary retriever and cannot initiate unbounded discovery.

D9 — Context-graph provider is a typed graph-client seam only. The research typed-edge experiment returned exact cross-source projections averaging 399 bytes versus 48,983 raw bytes (97.71% reduction), so a graph seam is justified; a separate graph database is not yet justified.
D10 — External/MCP-backed sources use the same ProviderCandidate and source-snapshot checks. MCP is transport only and cannot introduce MCP task/session/tool authority into Oracle semantics.

D11 — Zoekt is the lexical adapter target: Apache-2.0, sourcegraph/zoekt@153817f643cde8b229ee388c1dddbcf07f4798af, >=1,000 stars. It offers indexed code search plus repository branch/version metadata. BB-062 uses an injected client adapter rather than embedding the Go implementation.

D12 — Serena full application is not adopted: oraios/serena@7a2968335f2198b966864de1ce3655c8e485a653 is GPL-3.0-or-later while SolidLSP is MIT. BB-062 defines an injected semantic symbol client; LSP/SolidLSP remains an out-of-process implementation option.

D13 — Aider is inspiration/algorithm reuse only: Aider-AI/aider@5dc9490bb35f9729ef2c95d00a19ccd30c26339c, Apache-2.0, >=1,000 stars. Its definition/reference graph + PageRank + token budget informs structural projection but the application is not a dependency.

D14 — Graphiti and Cognee are not foundation dependencies. Graphiti@ba4a9cb32495b6864160616f8dfa2b898f4a500c and Cognee@eb90d03740755f5252b8b12cce91fd09970f2d81 are Apache-2.0 and >=1,000 stars; their temporal graph/code-memory capabilities remain comparison evidence for later Context Graph work.

D15 — Research family benchmark on the same 8-file/4-query corpus measured mean Recall@3 lexical=0.792, symbol=0.875, structural=0.750. This supports complementary lexical+semantic retrieval and rejects structural ranking as a universal primary retriever.

D16 — Planner fallback may switch provider implementations only when the same source/snapshot/currentness contract can still be proven. It may never weaken EXACT/CURRENT constraints, provenance requirements or budget.

D17 — Unsupported language, stale index, missing/renamed symbol, ambiguous symbol, unproven graph fact and external response without a strong source validator map to explicit typed provider failures/unresolved reasons; no silent downgrade.

D18 — Same-problem graph/context evidence: a disposable typed source graph over the identical 8-file/Q1-Q4 corpus used verified import/contract relations and bounded node/relation labels; it achieved mean Recall@3=1.000, Precision@3=0.667, MRR=1.000 and mean bytes@3=70,163. This closes the graph/context comparison on the same representative problems but is explicitly not a Graphiti/Cognee execution or backend-adoption result.
implementationSlices: S1 [PROVIDER_CONTRACT,INV-2,INV-3] — After BB-060/061 dependency outputs exist, add provider-contract.js and export the new provider/planner public surface through the dependency-created packages/oracle/src/index.js. Implement strict provider descriptors, ProviderCandidate normalization and typed provider failures. Provider metadata is Oracle-internal; reject lifecycle-authority fields and candidate source/currentness/provenance omissions.

S2 [CATALOG,CURRENTNESS,INV-2] — Add SourceCatalog with explicit composition-time provider registrations plus one authoritative snapshot authority per applicable source namespace. Fail on duplicate provider ids/authority ambiguity. For CURRENT, compare provider/index snapshotRef to authoritative snapshot; self-reported index freshness is insufficient.

S3 [ADAPTERS,PROVIDER_NEUTRALITY] — Add injected lexical-search and semantic-code adapters. Lexical adapter accepts a Zoekt-like search client and normalizes indexed repository/version/file/snippet results. Semantic adapter accepts a symbolClient with workspace-symbol/lookup/reference capabilities. Neither adapter imports external projects or exposes their protocol/tool commands above Oracle.

S4 [STRUCTURAL_GRAPH_EXTERNAL] — Add Aider-inspired structural-map projection over normalized symbol/reference edges; add typed context-graph client seam and external-source transport seam. Structural projection is bounded and cannot source-discover independently. Graph/external candidates require authoritative provenance/currentness paths.

S5 [PLANNER,BUDGET,INV-1,INV-3] — Add deterministic RetrievalPlanner producing bounded RetrievalWork. Reserve provider-call/item/byte budget before invocation. Exact item refs use exact providers; repository semantic needs compose semantic+lexical providers within budget; unsupported semantic lookup may fall back to lexical; structural refinement consumes existing edges; graph/external work is selected only for matching source kinds. No model call or Application scheduling primitive is used.

S6 [BENCHMARK] — Add bb062-retrieval-benchmark.mjs with the predeclared 8-file corpus and identical Q1-Q4 ground truth for FOUR arms: lexical, semantic/symbol, structural-map and typed graph/context. The typed-graph fixture must derive declared import/contract relations rather than use manually ranked answers. Report every arm/attempt, Recall@3, Precision@3, MRR, materialized bytes, latency, setup/update cost proxy and exact provenance/currentness coverage. Reference research results: lexical Recall@3=0.792, semantic=0.875, structural=0.750, typed graph/context=1.000; structural is not promoted to primary unless it matches/exceeds lexical. Separately retain the four cross-source authority queries and require exact answers with >=0.95 mean byte reduction.

S7 [NEGATIVE_INTEGRATION] — Add provider/planner/boundary tests for stale index versus authoritative head, unsupported language, deleted/renamed/ambiguous symbol, budget exhaustion, provider timeout, graph candidate without authoritative path, external/MCP response without validator, duplicate registrations, caller provider-command leakage and forbidden Oracle authority.

S8 [LIVING_TRUTH] — Update Oracle Living Docs with SourceCatalog/provider/planner topology and exact limitations. Explicitly state that Zoekt/LSP/Graphiti/Cognee runtimes are not bundled, graph persistence/durable ContextResolution lifecycle is not delivered, and model-assisted planning is not delivered.

negativeVerificationCases: ContextRequirement contains providerId/tool/operation/MCP method or caller selects a concrete provider.
SourceCatalog allows duplicate provider id or multiple unqualified snapshot authorities for one source namespace.
Zoekt-like result reports indexed revision X while authoritative repository head is Y and is still represented as CURRENT.
Semantic provider unsupported-language/ambiguous/deleted symbol silently becomes a valid exact semantic result.
Planner exceeds provider-call/item/materialized-byte budget or retries without reserved budget.
Planner invokes a model to select providers or exposes RetrievalWork as an agent/model tool.
Structural projection initiates unbounded retrieval rather than ranking already-normalized edges.
Graph candidate without authoritative provenance/currentness path satisfies REQUIRED evidence.
MCP/external transport success without exact source snapshot/validator satisfies CURRENT evidence.
Oracle/provider/planner claims work, accepts product output, publishes product truth, mutates external effects or owns domain recovery.
Graphiti/Cognee/Serena application is added as runtime dependency despite the research decision.
Living Docs claim durable ContextResolution cache/replay, graph persistence or model-assisted planning is delivered by BB-062.
